name: PCBA Partner Fabrication Toolkit
description: One-click Gerber/drill ZIP, BOM, CPL and a pre-flight check report for PCB assembly.
description_full:
Exports locally from the saved KiCad project: Gerber and Excellon drill ZIP, grouped BOM with normalized Manufacturer/MPN fields, pick-and-place CPL in mm, and a basic pre-flight report for missing MPNs, missing footprints and BOM/placement mismatches. No upload, network access or commercial-service connection is performed. The vendor-neutral output can be used with any assembler.

Validated on KiCad 10.0.6 for macOS. Uses the legacy SWIG action-plugin runtime and kicad-cli. Only KiCad 10.0 is currently declared compatible.
